component.name: Zalos
component.summary: High-performance, ultra-lightweight native Qt6 desktop client for Zalo on Linux

description.p: Zalos is a high-performance, ultra-lightweight native Linux messaging client for Zalo built with Qt6 (C++ and QML). It delivers a tiny memory footprint (~40-65MB RAM), sub-second cold startup, hardware-accelerated 60 FPS graphics, native Wayland and X11 support, adaptive system theming, and local End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) database synchronization.

ul.li: Native Wayland and Xorg dual-engine support with smooth Client-Side Decorations (CSD).
Adaptive Dark/Light theme following GNOME (Adwaita) and KDE (Breeze) desktop settings.
Native C++ cryptographic verification for E2EE message history (db-cross-v4).
StatusNotifierItem system tray integration with dynamic unread message badge count.
Ultra-low resource consumption: starts instantaneously with minimal CPU and RAM usage (~40–65 MB).
1-1 and group voice/video calling engine with OpenH264 video encoding.
Desktop utilities: screenshot capture (Ctrl+Alt+S), file transfer, Kiki assistant and My Documents browser.

description.p: Calls run on Zalos's own C++ engine with no Node.js or Python needed; fixed a crash when starting a call; lower memory use from lazily created pages and menus and a dedicated image path for chat photos.

Native C++ browser session reader, in-chat system notices and message logs for started/completed calls, mention cursor auto-positioning, unread group mentions filter in Direct tab, and call overlay controls alignment.

Group voice and video calls with participant state, the My Documents media/file/link browser, Kiki Assistant and zBusiness tool destinations, call and group actions hidden on official accounts, contacts quick actions, and a hardened mobile history sync.
Layered chat background blur, full-resolution cover and avatar images, faster packaging builds, unread badge resurrection fix, VoIP reject status handling, and session cookies scoped to Zalo domains.

Interactive draft attachments bar for multi-file queueing, in-app image viewer annotation canvas with drawing tools, window geometry persistence, dock unread counter, audio-only incoming call acceptance, and ARM64 AppImage release packaging.
Duplicate-message fix for mobile history resync (cliMsgId dedup), text emoticons rendered as emoji, a photo viewer that no longer initialises a media backend, and a minified GitHub Pages deployment.
Memory optimizations inspired by Telegram Desktop, complete mobile history sync with 64-bit znoise resolution, in-app video playback, avatar/background viewer, and ARM64 Nix build fixes.
First published release: pure Qt6 architecture, E2EE decryptor, and AppImage/RPM/.deb/Nix packaging for x86_64 and aarch64.
